text:
Maya R.: handing off to night shift — quick summary: low-priority infra work today, but a couple of things to watch.

Maya R.: 1) Model-serving error rate bumped ~0.6% at 17:20 UTC after the tensorflow patch; we rolled a hotfix to the model pool (v2.3.1) but keep an eye.

Maya R.: 2) DB vacuum scheduled at 02:30 UTC — will be disruptive for long-running queries (>30s). Not likely to impact inference but might affect metrics backfill.

Maya R.: 3) CPU on scheduler instances creeping up on eu-west-1 autoscale group, threshold set at 70%. I opened a ticket: INV-548.

Jordan K.: picking this up. where's the runbook for the tf patch rollback if we need it? :thumbsup:

Maya R.: runbook snippet is pasted below — use the rollback tag `tf-patch-2024-07` and redeploy model-pool.

Maya R.: ```bash
# quick rollback
redwoodctl deploy model-pool --image redwood/model:v2.3.0 --tag tf-patch-rollback
redwoodctl rollout status model-pool
```

Priya S.: heads-up — I'm swapping nights with Jordan Wednesday-Thursday (I've got infra interviews). Jordan, can you confirm you'll cover the swap? @Jordan K.

Jordan K.: yep confirmed. I'll cover Wed/Thu nights. Priya, please DM me any context if you want me to escalate to Carlos for the DB vacuum.

Carlos M.: FYI I patched a minor logging memleak in the metrics aggregator earlier, deployed at 15:10 UTC. Logs look clean but I'm around if anything spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy model-pool:v2.3.1 succeeded for cluster us-east-1 at 17:25 UTC (trigger: auto-hotfix).

Maya R.: action items for night oncall: check model error rate every hour, confirm DB vacuum completes (monitor long queries), and ensure scheduler cpu stays under 75% or raise INV-548 to sev2 if >80%.

Jordan K.: will run health checks at H+0, H+1, H+2 and post updates here. quick health command: 

Jordan K.: ```bash
# health-checks for oncall
redwoodctl check models --region eu-west-1 --metric error-rate --since 1h
redwoodctl top nodes --filter scheduler --region eu-west-1
```

Priya S.: added a note to the oncall doc about the interview swap. Also linked INV-548 and the DB vacuum schedule.

Maya R.: small risk: if the vacuum kicks while metrics backfill runs, we might see a storm of metric rebuild jobs. If that happens, please pause backfill: `redwoodctl job pause metrics-backfill` and ping me.

Jordan K.: understood. pinging now if anything odd shows up. good handoff, thanks Maya. :raised_hands:

oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder — next rotation changeover in 7 days for night shift.

Maya R.: leaving Slack notifications on until 18:00 UTC, reachable on phone for 1hr after. Good luck!
